title: Dead Ruins
summary: Situ Nan falls into a deep sleep after spending too much of his Nascent Soul essence, and Wang Lin sets out alone to find a yin-rich place, promising to wake him by forming a core. In ruins that were destroyed overnight, a land of countless deaths, he begins the Underworld Ascension Method, whose nine levels force open three aperture points and form cold cores that may lead straight to Core Formation. A strange figure in yellow paper attacks him; Wang Lin sees through its Core Formation disguise and wins an illusion bead in exchange for his Little Lost Formation. Moving deeper, he breaks through to the fifth level of the method in a tenth-grade extreme-yin spot. A sane corpse puppet called Adai has followed him, hunting the master it rebelled against. That master, Corpse Yin Sect ancestor Wu Yu, is trapped as a Nascent Soul in a statue and offers to teleport Wang Lin to the Corpse Yin Sect if he will bring back his junior brother Ye Zizai, and Wang Lin accepts.
events: Situ Nan sleeps; Wang Lin leaves to find an extreme-yin place
Wang Lin sets up the Little Lost Formation and starts the Underworld Ascension Method
A yellow-paper weirdo attacks; Wang Lin sees through the Core Formation illusion and gains an illusion bead
In a stronger yin spot, he completes the fifth level of the method
The sane corpse puppet Adai follows him, searching for its master's Nascent Soul
Wu Yu, a Corpse Yin Sect ancestor trapped in a statue, explains corpse puppets and begs for help
Wu Yu opens a teleportation array to the Corpse Yin Sect, and Wang Lin goes to fetch Ye Zizai
cultivation: The Underworld Ascension Method has nine levels; every three levels break one aperture (dantian, qi sea, foot aperture) and form a cold core, and merging the three cold cores can lead directly to Core Formation. Wang Lin completes the fifth level. Wu Yu is a Nascent Soul ancestor of the Corpse Yin Sect.
